pairs.original:
1. Cryptocurrency will continue to dominate personal finance, and holding a significant portion of your portfolio in lesser-known altcoins can lead to extraordinary returns.  
2. Peer-to-peer lending platforms are set to replace traditional banks in many functions, offering higher returns for lenders and more accessible loans for borrowers.  
3. The future of investing heavily relies on leveraging technology, especially artificial intelligence, to make real-time, data-driven investment decisions.
